recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，散佈好幾顆大型的巨核細胞（megakaryocytes），數量正常至增加；在 TTP 中這代表周邊血小板被消耗、骨髓巨核細胞代償，並非 TTP 特有的型態。
features: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear with cellular spread
Several megakaryocytes present, normal to increased in number, with lobulated nuclei
Numerous small hematopoietic cells scattered between red cell streaks
No abnormal clusters or blasts identifiable at this magnification
Cytologic detail limited by low magnification
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with numerous hematopoietic cells dispersed among red cells. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and appear normal to increased in number, without obvious clustering. Detailed evaluation of erythroid hyperplasia or megakaryocytic morphology requires higher magnification. Findings are consistent with adequate to increased megakaryopoiesis, supporting a peripheral consumptive cause of thrombocytopenia such as thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, but are not specific.

ddx.vs: ITP also shows increased megakaryocytes; separation depends on schistocytes, hemolysis markers and ADAMTS13 activity in TTP.
Production failure shows reduced or absent megakaryocytes, which argues against consumption.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered and atypical, with thrombocytosis rather than thrombocytopenia.
